info.title: Nuvio public API
info.description: The Nuvio API gives third-party clients public REST and RPC endpoints for working with Nuvio user data. Its Supabase-compatible interface supports authenticated operations for profiles, addons, library, watch progress, watch history, collections, and profile settings.

tags.name: Profiles
tags.description: Current public Nuvio clients support up to **6 profiles**. Addons, library, watch progress, watch history, settings, and collections are scoped by `profile_id`.

tags.name: Addons
tags.description: Addons are compatible integration URLs tied to a user profile. Depending on the manifest, they can provide catalog, metadata, subtitle, or playback details.

tags.name: Library
tags.description: The library stores content that each profile has bookmarked or favorited.

tags.name: Watch progress
tags.description: Watch progress stores playback positions for the "continue watching" feature. Pushes use a **non-destructive merge**: they upsert entries and do not delete entries omitted from the payload.

tags.name: Watch history
tags.description: Watch history records content that a profile has watched. Pushes use a **non-destructive merge**.

tags.name: Profile settings
tags.description: Profile settings use a generic JSON key-value store for each profile. Examples include themes, player preferences, and UI options. Supplying `p_platform` gives the settings a platform namespace.

tags.name: Home catalog settings
tags.description: Nuvio stores each profile's home catalog configuration as a JSON blob. It is separate from the general profile settings blob, which lets clients sync home layout and catalog preferences independently.

tags.name: Collections
tags.description: Each profile stores its custom content collections in a JSON blob.

tags.name: Avatars
tags.description: The avatar catalog lists the profile avatars currently available. Clients should also support `avatar_color_hex` and `avatar_url` from profile rows because a custom avatar URL does not require a catalog entry.

tags.name: Supporter Wall
tags.description: This public website endpoint returns the Top and Recent views of The Wall in one request. It does not require authentication and exposes only the same public name, avatar, tier, and member-since fields shown on the Support page. The response permits cross-origin reads, so it can be used directly by other public Nuvio sites.

tags.name: Sync overview
tags.description: This endpoint returns core sync data counts for each profile. Clients can use the counts in dashboards and status displays.

tags.name: Health check
tags.description: Use this endpoint to check the API and database health. It does not require authentication.

post.description:
This endpoint fully replaces profiles within the declared client range. It **deletes** profiles omitted from the array for slots `1..p_client_max_profiles`.

Top-level body fields:

Profile object fields:

**Note:** This endpoint never overwrites PIN fields. PIN management is an app-specific Nuvio flow and is not part of the public API.

p_client_max_profiles.description: Highest profile slot this client manages. Use `6` for current public clients. Defaults to `4` when omitted.

p_profiles.description: Complete profile list for the declared profile range

profile_index.description: 1 to 6 in the public client surface

avatar_id.description: Avatar catalog ID; existing value is kept if omitted or null and `avatar_url` is not provided

avatar_url.description: Custom avatar image URL. When provided, it takes precedence over `avatar_id`; send `null` or `""` to clear it.

post.description: This endpoint deletes **all** public data associated with a profile: addons, collections, watch progress, library, watched items, and the profile row itself.

profile_id.description: Profile index (1 to 6 in the public client surface)

post.description:
This endpoint fully replaces the specified profile's addons. It **deletes** any addon omitted from the array.

**Deduplication:** Addons are keyed by `md5(url)` per user and profile. A push updates a row only when `name`, `enabled`, or `sort_order` has changed.

This endpoint returns one page of the current library snapshot. It remains available for bootstrap, recovery, and older clients.

Results are ordered by `added_at DESC`.

Increase `p_offset` by the requested `p_limit` until the response contains fewer rows than the limit. The recommended page size for large libraries is 500 rows.

This endpoint returns the highest library event ID available for the profile, or `0` if the profile has no events.

Capture this cursor before pulling the paginated snapshot. When the snapshot is complete, pull events after this cursor to apply changes that occurred during bootstrap.

This endpoint returns library changes after a stored event cursor. Results are ordered by `event_id ASC`.

After each page, save the highest `event_id`. Request the next page from that cursor until a page contains fewer rows than `p_limit`.

p_since_event_id.description: Return events with an ID greater than this cursor

post.description:
This endpoint inserts or updates only the supplied items. It preserves existing library items that are not in the request.

Send large writes in batches. Nuvio clients use at most 500 items per request.

p_origin_client_id.description: Stable installation identifier attached to emitted sync events

post.description:
This endpoint deletes only the supplied `(content_id, content_type)` keys. It preserves items not listed in the request.

Send large deletes in batches. Nuvio clients use at most 500 keys per request.

p_origin_client_id.description: Stable installation identifier attached to emitted sync events

post.description:
This compatibility endpoint performs a full replace for existing clients. It **deletes** items omitted from the array for the specified profile.

New clients should use `sync_push_library_items` and `sync_delete_library_items` instead. Do not send partial state to this legacy endpoint.

Without `p_since_last_watched`, this endpoint returns the latest progress entries for the profile in `last_watched DESC` order. Use the delta endpoints below when you need delete events or a stable event cursor.

p_since_last_watched.description: Optional epoch-millisecond cursor. When set, returns rows with `last_watched` greater than this value.

p_limit.description: Optional row limit. Without `p_since_last_watched`, the server caps the result at 200 rows.

post.description:
This endpoint returns upsert and delete events after a stored event cursor. Use it for incremental sync after the client completes its initial snapshot pull.

Apply events in ascending `event_id` order and save the highest `event_id` you process.

p_since_event_id.description: Return events with `event_id` greater than this value

p_limit.description: Max events to return, capped at `1000`

post.description: This endpoint returns the current maximum watch-progress event ID for the profile. After a full snapshot sync, call it and save the returned value as the next `p_since_event_id`.

This endpoint uses a non-destructive merge. It upserts entries and does **not** delete entries omitted from the request.

**Completion handling:** When an entry has `duration >= 60000` and `position` is at least 90% of `duration`, the server also upserts a matching watched-history item. The server may ignore tiny progress changes to reduce write volume.

post.summary: Delete watch progress (single) / Delete watch progress (batch)

post.description: Results are ordered by `watched_at DESC`.

This endpoint returns watched-history upsert and delete events after a stored event cursor. Use it for incremental sync after the client completes its initial snapshot pull.

Apply events in ascending `event_id` order and save the highest `event_id` you process.

p_since_event_id.description: Return events with `event_id` greater than this value

p_limit.description: Max events to return, capped at `1000`

post.description: This endpoint returns the current maximum watched-history event ID for the profile. After a full snapshot sync, call it and save the returned value as the next `p_since_event_id`.
This endpoint uses a non-destructive merge and only upserts entries.
The `settings_json` field accepts any JSON object. The server does not enforce a schema; your application defines the structure.

p_platform.description: Optional platform namespace. Recommended for new clients.

post.description: This atomic upsert fully replaces the settings blob for the profile.
The `settings_json` payload is application-defined JSON.

p_platform.description: Optional platform namespace. Recommended for new clients.

pinToTop.description: Pin to top of home screen

post.description: This endpoint fully replaces the profile's collections blob. Send an empty array (`[]`) to clear it.

This endpoint does not require authentication.

The response may be an empty array if no catalog avatars are currently published.

id.description: Avatar ID for use in profile `avatar_id`

get.description:
This public website endpoint returns the Top and Recent views of The Wall in one request. It does not require authentication and exposes only the same public name, avatar, tier, and member-since fields shown on the Support page. The response permits cross-origin reads, so it can be used directly by other public Nuvio sites.

`supporterSince` is `null` for one-time memberships. Members who opt out of The Wall are excluded from both lists. Payment amounts, account IDs, emails, and provider details are never returned.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Shared pagination offset for both lists.

post.description:
This endpoint returns core sync data counts for each profile. Clients can use the counts in dashboards and status displays.

Each key in the data objects is a profile index. The `profiles` entry includes the display name and color. This overview currently documents addons, library items, watch progress, watched items, and profiles only; it does not include collections, profile settings, or home catalog settings.
